primitives.name: Conditional Qualification Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression p̂_h(x) = ΣK((x-Xi)/h)Yi / ΣK((x-Xi)/h) (Gaussian kernel, h0 = 0.525 by AIC) estimates the conditional qualification probability p(x).

Using Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression allows estimation of p(x) without assuming a parametric form such as logistic. The key innovation is constructing valid confidence intervals using Wilson or Agresti-Coull methods tailored for binary responses, which avoids reliance on asymptotic normality. These intervals are computed using a local effective sample size derived from kernel weights. A novel bootstrap procedure selects optimal bandwidth h that maximizes average coverage probability, ensuring reliable inference even under finite-sample conditions. This approach addresses confounding due to preferential seeding by conditioning on strength differences, making the analysis more robust than naive comparisons. The method enables precise quantification of SLHA while providing honest uncertainty bounds, suitable for risk-sensitive applications like betting strategies or portfolio management.
